llm.summary: The skill mostly matches its OCR purpose, but its setup instructions tell users to run an unverified internet installer, so it should be reviewed before installation.

dimensions.detail: The allowed tool surface is limited to Bash(oo *), and normal OCR operations use the OOMOL connector with server-side credentials, but OCR image data is necessarily sent through the connector service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes curl-to-bash and PowerShell Invoke-Expression installer commands for the oo CLI without version pinning, checksum verification, signature verification, or explicit user approval before running the installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger says to use the skill for any OCR.space request, which is broad but still service-specific; the runtime steps are scoped to inspecting and running OCR.space connector actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not include bundled executable code, background workers, memory writes, or hidden persistence; installing and authenticating the oo CLI may create normal local CLI state as part of setup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single OCR.space connector skill using the oo CLI for extract_text and get_conversion_stats; the declared capabilities match the stated OCR purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the setup path before installing. Prefer installing the oo CLI from a trusted, versioned source with checksum or signature verification, and do not let an agent run the installer automatically. Once the CLI is installed and authenticated, the listed OCR actions appear aligned with OCR.space use.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: The artifact does include remote shell installer commands; installing the required CLI is purpose-related, but immediate execution of an unpinned remote installer is broader than necessary.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad OCR.space activation language is present, but it remains limited to this named service and is a scoping note rather than the main review concern.
[T03] unexpected: The static finding is supported by the setup commands in the artifact; no malicious payload is bundled, but the install path depends on mutable remote script contents.
